The '''Stark Forests''' was a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] region on the continent of [[Thyr]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The trees of the Stark Forests sucked moisture from the air and stored [[Water/Legends|water]] in leathery sacks that hung like pendulums from their skeletal branches, and the sacs were useful to travelers who were passing through the area. A small stream ran through part of the forests, and [[hook hawk]]s&mdash;carnivorous birds native to Tython that hypnotized their victims with song&mdash;were often found in flocks in the Stark Forests.<ref name="Into the Void" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Stark Forests first appeared in a flashback in the novel ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'', which was written by [[Tim Lebbon]] and released on [[May 7]], [[2013]].
